metadata.schema_version: v2 (sampled Tb + sampled core + derived rho_sil)
metadata.description: Phase C1 BodyConfig: Europa with Seawater ocean and Andrade rheology, 7D (rheology + Tb_K + sampled core) with mass-conservation rho_sil. Observables (2026-07-12): CMR2 = 0.3547+/-0.0024 (Gomez Casajus et al. 2021); k2/h2 Mazarico et al. (2023) assumption values Re_k2 = 0.25+/-0.06, Im_k2 = 0+/-0.06, Re_h2 = 1.20+/-0.10, Im_h2 = 0+/-0.10 (see observables_provenance_2026_07_12); Galileo synodic induction as one-sided support bounds (see induction_bounds_rationale).
metadata.primary_constraint: CMR2 from Gomez Casajus et al. (2021)
metadata.k2_status: ASSUMPTION values per Mazarico et al. (2023) ocean-case expectations, not measurements (superseded the earlier generic placeholders; see observables_provenance_2026_07_12). Replace with measured values when Europa Clipper data land.
metadata.Tb_bounds_rationale: Tb_K=[259.5, 271.0] K targets the geological-likely range D_iceIh=[~3, ~100] km. Lower bound: 259.5 K is the coldest Tb at which PP's MoI iteration converges with the default Europa template's R_core/rho_sil bounds (gives D_iceIh=98.3 km, D_ocean=0 km — the no-ocean limit). Going colder requires widening the template's silicate-density search. Upper bound: 271.0 K gives D_iceIh=2.65 km; above ~271.25 K PP raises 'No valid phase transition' (ice shell extinct). Probed via PlanetProfile.Inference.find_tb_bounds, 2026-05-23.
metadata.core_bounds_rationale: R_core in [0, 0.5 R_body] permits the no-core limit; rho_core in [5000, 8000] kg/m^3 brackets metallic Fe / Fe-S compositions. rho_sil is derived from M_total mass conservation given the cached ice+ocean profile and sampled core; samples with rho_sil outside [2200, 3500] kg/m^3 are rejected by the likelihood.
metadata.stage2_dependencies: Toolkit must (a) parse the derived_params block, (b) implement the rho_sil mass-conservation solver and rejection, (c) extend the structure cache to include M_ice_kg / M_ocean_kg / R_oceanbot_m / M_total_kg per Tb point, (d) recompute CMR2 from the sampled core + derived rho_sil + cached ice/ocean profile.
metadata.stage3_dependencies: Build Tb-grid structure cache for Europa with seawater ocean across the sampled Tb range.
metadata.observables_provenance_2026_07_12: CMR2: Gomez Casajus et al. (2021), unchanged. k2/h2: Mazarico et al. (2023, SSRv 219:30) ASSUMPTION values, not measurements (user directive 2026-07-12): Re_k2 = 0.25 (midpoint of the ocean-case expectation range 0.18-0.32) with sigma = 0.06 (GSWG requirement); Im_k2 = 0 +/- 0.06; Re_h2 = 1.20 (ocean-case nominal, range 0.8-1.3) with sigma = 0.10 (REASON accuracy); Im_h2 = 0 +/- 0.10. Diagonal Gaussians: cross-instrument measurement errors approximately independent; the physical k2-h2 correlation is enforced by the forward model.
metadata.induction_bounds_rationale: Galileo synodic induction treated as one-sided support cuts, NOT Gaussian observables (user directive 2026-07-12): normalized amplitude |Ae_synodic| > 0.7 (literature point values 0.92/0.97 are over-interpretations) and |Im(Ae_synodic)| < 0.4 (modeling, Mahboub et al. 2026; < 0.2 favored by low-salinity ocean models - retained as the E6 sensitivity variant, not the default). The previous 8 computed-placeholder Ae Gaussian channels are removed. Because Ae depends only on Tb via the cached conductivity profile, each bound is exactly a Tb-support cut; enforced as hard rejection in the MCMC likelihood and as training-time support rejection in SBI dataset generation. NOTE: on the SBI side the bound is enforced at TRAINING time by row rejection (the ratified no-ocean-guard precedent); the trained flow is a smooth density estimator and may assign small nonzero density across the cut Tb region at sampling time — the SBI support equals the MCMC support in the learned/approximate sense, not as a hard truncation.
metadata.induction_bounds_tb_diagnostic_2026_07_1: Authoring-time evaluation over the 36-pt Tb grid: |Ae_synodic| rises monotonically from 0.067 (Tb=259.5 K, near-frozen ocean) through the amp_min=0.7 threshold between Tb=261.0 (|Ae|=0.643) and 261.5 K (0.754), reaching 0.939 at 271.0 K; |Im Ae| peaks at 0.383 (Tb=261.0, inside the cut) and stays <= 0.31 in the surviving region, so im_abs_max=0.4 is currently non-binding. The bounds cut a SINGLE contiguous low-Tb interval: surviving support is Tb in [~261.5, 271.0] K (26/36 grid points). Physical reading: the induction constraint requires a present, conductive ocean. Cross-check available via prior truncation at Tb >= 261.5 K.
